g.text: Title: Linap bench - Wemos D1 mini on the Linap bus

g.desc: Title: Linap bench - Wemos D1 mini on the Linap bus

g.text: Sauter Marapi tactile - Linap bus discovery

g.desc: Sauter Marapi tactile - Linap bus discovery

g.text: Firmwares: discovery/<stage>/*.yaml - procedure and revisions: discovery/README.md

g.desc: Firmwares: discovery/<stage>/*.yaml - procedure and revisions: discovery/README.md

g.style: fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;
fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;
fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;

g.text: ON THE RADIATOR (STAGES 1 AND 3), EVERYTHING INSIDE THE RED FRAME IS AT MAINS POTENTIAL

g.desc: ON THE RADIATOR (STAGES 1 AND 3), EVERYTHING INSIDE THE RED FRAME IS AT MAINS POTENTIAL

g.text: TX: D8 high -> Q1 on -> DATA low (UART inverted)

g.desc: TX: D8 high -> Q1 on -> DATA low (UART inverted)

g.text: 3. Wire with the breaker OFF. Once powered, touch nothing: read and drive over Wi-Fi only.

g.desc: 3. Wire with the breaker OFF. Once powered, touch nothing: read and drive over Wi-Fi only.

g.text: 2. Lab supply output must float: no earth terminal, no link between - and earth. Set 5.0 V, limit 300 mA.

g.desc: 2. Lab supply output must float: no earth terminal, no link between - and earth. Set 5.0 V, limit 300 mA.

g.text: 1. Flash over USB BEFORE wiring, then unplug it for good: never USB while J2 reaches the power board.

g.desc: 1. Flash over USB BEFORE wiring, then unplug it for good: never USB while J2 reaches the power board.

g.text: Stage 2, power emulator (bench, NO MAINS): J2 to the command board alone. USB powers, J1 unplugged, JP1 closed.

g.desc: Stage 2, power emulator (bench, NO MAINS): J2 to the command board alone. USB powers, J1 unplugged, JP1 closed.

g.text: Stage 1, sniffer (radiator): J2 taps the ribbon between both boards. J1 powers, JP1 open. Q1 stays off.

g.desc: Stage 1, sniffer (radiator): J2 taps the ribbon between both boards. J1 powers, JP1 open. Q1 stays off.

g.text: Divider: 5.2 V x 15k / 25k = 3.1 V on D2 (GPIO4)

g.desc: Divider: 5.2 V x 15k / 25k = 3.1 V on D2 (GPIO4)

g.text: Stage 3, controller emulator (radiator): J2 to the power board alone. J1 powers, JP1 open.

g.desc: Stage 3, controller emulator (radiator): J2 to the power board alone. J1 powers, JP1 open.

g.text: R7 (crossed: stage 3 only): the command board is the bus pull-up, so the power board alone needs R7.

g.desc: R7 (crossed: stage 3 only): the command board is the bus pull-up, so the power board alone needs R7.

g.text: Revision 1 (2026-11-07): listen only. Revision 2 (2026-11-08): Q1 + R6 transmit from D8, R7 optional pull-up.

g.desc: Revision 1 (2026-11-07): listen only. Revision 2 (2026-11-08): Q1 + R6 transmit from D8, R7 optional pull-up.
